strings: m_c has entered a catatonic state, not responding to anything around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
When r_c went to get m_c for their patrol, {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} noticed m_c was in a catatonic state.
r_c tries to talk to m_c, but m_c doesn't even seem to notice {PRONOUN/r_c/object}. It seems m_c is in a catatonic state.
m_c has entered a catatonic state. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/were/was} brought to r_c's den for monitoring and care.
r_c is worried about m_c: {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} is just sitting there, not even responding to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} mate. Gently, r_c1 informs r_c that m_c is in a catatonic state.
